channel.title: What does these kicksecure packages do?
channel.description:
When trying to uninstall certain preinstalled applications, `kicksecure-genreal-gui-all` and `kicksecure-qubes-gui-lxqt` gets removed as well.
Out of curiosity, what are these packages for? I assume that removing them is unproblematic.

item.title: What does these kicksecure packages do?
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
ks44:

Out of curiosity, what are these packages for?

These are metapackages designed to ensure you have all the software that makes up Kicksecure properly installed.

ks44:

I assume that removing them is unproblematic.

Removing them is problematic, you will potentially impair your ability to properly install security updates in the future. You should reinstall these packages.

If you want to remove preinstalled software that a metapackage depends on, use dummy-dependency:
